core_obligations: Reformulate: over a smooth presentation the comparison morphism between the relative inertia and the pullback of the inertia becomes a morphism of group spaces G to H, which is etale by unramifiedness, and condition (1) is exactly that this morphism is an isomorphism (proof lines 10025-10037)
Condition (2) is the same as the fibre-by-fibre isomorphism condition for that morphism (proof lines 10033-10037)

(2) implies (1): if every fibre is an isomorphism then the morphism is surjective and universally injective, hence an isomorphism because it is etale, and so condition (1) holds (proof lines 10038-10042)
proof_roadmap: 取 U → X 满光滑，把 I_X → X ×_Y I_Y 拉回为 G → H；由 unramified 的刻画，G → H 是 étale。
(1) ⟺ G → H 是同构；(2) ⟺ 每条纤维 G_u → H_u 是同构 ⇒ (1)⇒(2) 平凡。
(2)⇒(1)：G → H 满、一致单射且 étale ⇒ 由代数空间层面的判据是同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for an unramified morphism of algebraic stacks, the relative inertia mapping isomorphically to the pullback of the inertia precisely when the morphism induces isomorphisms between the automorphism groups of points and their images (author lemma at source lines 10011-10023, label lemma-aut-iso-unramified). The proof (source lines 10025-10043) presents the source, identifies the comparison morphism with an etale morphism of group spaces, translates both conditions into statements about that morphism and concludes the nontrivial implication by the criterion that an etale universally injective morphism is an isomorphism (proof lines 10025-10042). The presentation of the comparison morphism and the fibre-by-fibre analysis are the substance. H3.
